nodes.title: SG-4.2.3 Enforce the tracked-dependency check in the test script
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts has assertNoTrackedNodeModules but nothing runs it. Desired behavior: npm test fails whenever git tracks any node_modules or vitest cache path. Why: stops vendored Phaser and cache files from being committed again.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a tracked path containing node_modules or a .vite cache directory, when the guard runs, then it throws naming that path
- Given the frontend package.json, when npm test is read, then it runs the guard before vitest


## Scope
- In scope: guard helper and CLI script
- In scope: test script wiring in game/frontend/package.json
- Out of scope: untracking files again
- Out of scope: CI manifests
- Preserve: existing trackedNodeModulesPaths, untrackNodeModules and assertNoTrackedNodeModules behavior
- Preserve: test:phaser-pin script


## Technical constraints
- Use vite-node already used by untrack:node-modules
- No new dependencies


## Definition of done
- npm test runs the guard first and fails on tracked dependency or cache paths


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Guard reports tracked dependency and test-cache paths from git ls-files output
nodes.body:
Context: trackedNodeModulesPaths only matches a node_modules segment and nothing reads real git output. Desired: parse NUL-separated git ls-files output and flag node_modules or .vite segments. Why: the guard needs real tracked file lists.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given paths including node_modules/a.js and src/.vite/x.json, when filtered, then both are returned and src/a.ts is not
- Given git ls-files -z output, when parsed, then empty entries are dropped and paths split on NUL


## Scope
- In scope: src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts additions
- Out of scope: running git in tests
- Preserve: existing exports


## Technical constraints
- Pure functions; git runner injected via GitRunner type


## Definition of done
- Helpers exported and typed

nodes.body:
Context: package.json test is only vitest run. Desired: test runs the guard script then vitest, and the script exits non-zero when tracked dependency or cache paths exist. Why: enforcement.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a git runner returning a tracked node_modules path, when the guard main runs, then it throws and exit code is non-zero
- Given package.json, when scripts.test is read, then it invokes the guard before vitest run

- In scope: package.json scripts

- Preserve: test:phaser-pin and untrack:node-modules scripts
